gen-dafont-nordic-gf-carrois-gothic: Ancient and powerful, Nordic spaces its letters like far-apart brush dabs, each one pinched shut and drawn in a single line width. Carrois Gothic sans-serif answers with a high x-height and open curves, so a longer stretch of it reads smoothly and modern.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Nordic draws every letter like rounded wire, closed up tight and spaced out wide. Carrois Gothic SC stays approachable beneath it, its curves open at every end and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals; a modest size gap would suit them.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-chivo: Chivo reads friendly and businesslike, with lowercase packed up near the caps and daylight in every curve. Nordic is the one for ancient, brush-dab drama in closed letters, while Chivo does the quiet, open work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-chocolate-classical: Chocolate Classical Sans reads modern and sizable, its broad-pen strokes never curling shut on themselves. Nordic's flat, constant line weight hums above it, ancient and sparse.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-comme: Nordic looks like drafting-pen outlines, one nib width throughout, with letters spaced like brush dabs far apart on paper. Comme sans-serif keeps its lowercase big and curves unclogged, so it settles the page.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-cossette-texte: Nordic is powerful and ancient, its letters pinched shut. Cossette Texte sans reads clean over a long passage, with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes, a prominent x-height, and arches as heavy as its stems.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide open and clean, its small letters dominating the line while ascenders barely show. Nordic sits above as a single-weight outline with brush-dab spacing, so the heading feels carved and the sans feels easy.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-fresca: Fresca reads modern and clean, with no calligraphic thinning and counters that stay connected to the space outside. Nordic's cramped, closed letters add ancient weight, and the gap between that and Fresca's openness is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-funnel-sans: Clean and professional, Funnel Sans keeps ascenders barely above the x-height and its lowercase e open like a pried clasp. Nordic stays powerful and ancient above it, but a long passage in Funnel Sans would read with steady, uniform strokes.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-gafata: Nordic holds every stem and join at one width, spaced like brush dabs and pinched shut. And Gafata plain sans offers the opposite temperament, a tall band of lowercase with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes.
